evaluation_basis: Assessed for live public-universe eligibility, purged OOS comparison, cost accounting and fold-stable superiority over simple baselines.
original_objective: Compare Logistic, HGB and Random Forest with Momentum, Ichimoku and Equal-Weight baselines across an eligible multi-asset universe.

engineering_result.summary: Collection, eligibility, purged OOS tournament, evidence validation and artifact upload passed; the v0.9 pagination defect was corrected first.

scientific_result.summary: Logistic was the best learned model but failed clear baseline superiority and fold-stability gates; Ichimoku survived only as an unstable baseline/challenger.

economic_result.summary: Ichimoku +32.04%/Sharpe 1.578, Equal Weight +24.90%/1.512, Logistic +8.97%/0.717; HGB -39.94% and RF -37.52%. Aggregate positives were regime/fold concentrated.

contribution_to_next_version: Selected multi-seed bootstrap/FDR and regime analysis as v0.11 rather than routing the aggregate winner to execution.
